name: Ring Nebula
tagline: A dying Sun's smoke ring — the planetary nebula every telescope knows.
history: The Ring Nebula is the textbook planetary nebula — the glowing shell a Sun-like star puffed off as it died, now lit from within by its exposed white-dwarf core. What looks like a flat ring is actually a donut-shaped shell of ionized gas seen nearly end-on; Hubble and JWST reveal intricate halos, knots and radial spokes. Every Sun-mass star, including ours, ends this way — a brief, beautiful exhalation before fading to a cinder.
